acceptance: Root volume has sustained free headroom (owner-defined threshold, e.g. >5%)
todo-db reads/writes no longer fail with ENOSPC
context: On 2026-10-06 the host root volume hit 100% capacity (115Mi free on a 926Gi disk; ~/Developer/benchmark_runs alone 298G). todo-db list_items failed with ENOSPC and the session event log reported degradation. Tracker access recovered later without agent action, so pressure is intermittent. Do not delete benchmark_runs or other owner data without explicit owner approval of exact paths.
description: Investigate what is filling the disk (benchmark run retention? logs? caches?), set a retention/pruning policy with owner approval, and add monitoring or a guard so tooling (tracker, event log, CI artifacts) degrades loudly before writes start failing.
